text:
[LCYC.1.1] **DS admits no unbounded computation.** The
principle is cross-cutting; it is enforced at each of
the following points:

idris.name: Lcyc_1_1__inv
idris.note: The run invariant: live values in the domain, one token table per rule, well-formed tokens, every table settled.

idris.name: Lcyc_1_1__lex_lt
idris.note: Lexicographic order on equal-length vectors of naturals.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp1
idris.note: First component: domain values not yet live for the stratum's emitted-and-read kinds, plus live facts of its withdrawn kinds.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp2
idris.note: Second component: pending activations of the stratum's rules.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__dom_of
idris.note: The domain of a run: the program's literals plus the input working memory's values -- what the measure's headroom term ranges over.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__indexed_from
idris.note: Pair every element with its index.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lex_acc
idris.note: Every vector is accessible: the order is well-founded.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lex_acc_len
idris.note: Every vector of a given length is accessible, by induction on the length with the head's natural-number accessibility inside.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lex_len
idris.note: Lexicographically related vectors have equal length.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lex_nil
idris.note: Nothing is below the empty vector.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__measure
idris.note: The measure: for each stratum, (headroom of its emitted-and-read kinds plus live count of its withdrawn kinds, pending activations), flattened in stratum order.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__measure_from
idris.note: The measure over strata a .. a+n-1.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_append
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All over ++.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_filter
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All survives a filter.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_from_elem
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A property at every member gives All.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_lookup
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All gives the property at a member.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_map
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All over map.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_map_maybe
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All over mapMaybe.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__and_false_l
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Conjunction, false on the left.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__and_false_r
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Conjunction, false on the right.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__and_true_l
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Conjunction, left projection.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__and_true_r
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Conjunction, right projection.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__any_append_l
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. any over ++, left.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__any_append_r
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. any over ++, right.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__any_elem
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A member passing the test makes any true.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__any_false_all
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. any false means the test fails everywhere.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__bool_not_both
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A Bool is not both True and False.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_append_inv
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem in ++ is Elem in one side.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_append_left
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem into the left of ++.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_append_right
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem into the right of ++.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_concat_map
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem into concatMap.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_concat_map_inv
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem in concatMap has a source.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_filter_fwd
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem into a filter it passes.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_filter_inv
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem in a filter is Elem plus the test.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_append_inv
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool membership in ++ is membership in one side.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_append_left
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool membership into the left of ++.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_append_right
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool membership into the right of ++.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_elem
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool membership on naturals gives Elem.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_false_not
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool non-membership refutes Elem.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_true
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem on naturals gives Bool membership.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_map_fwd
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem through map.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_map_inv
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem in a map has a preimage.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_ext
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Extensionally equal predicates filter alike.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_lte
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A stronger predicate keeps no more.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_strict
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Strictly fewer when it drops something the weaker keeps.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__find_nothing_cons
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. find failing on a cons fails on the head and the tail.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__headroom
idris.note: Domain values with no live fact of the kind carrying them -- what a monotone relation emit consumes.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__headroom_frame
idris.note: Headroom of another kind is untouched by a change confined to one.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__headroom_insert_lt
idris.note: A relation insert of a domain value strictly lowers that kind's headroom.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__length_set_at
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A position update preserves length.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__length_zip_with
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. zipWith of equal lengths has that length.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nat_eq_false
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Propositional inequality to Bool.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nat_eq_refl
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool equality is reflexive.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nat_eq_true
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool equality on naturals to propositional.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nat_neq_false
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool inequality to propositional.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__not_false_is_true
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Negation, the other.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__not_true_is_false
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Negation, one direction.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_elem
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth returns a member.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_length
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Equal lengths: a position defined on one side is defined on the other.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_map
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth commutes with map.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_nothing_length
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. And undefined on one side is undefined on the other.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_set_at_eq
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth at the updated position sees the update.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_set_at_neq
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth elsewhere does not.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_zip_with_just
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth of zipWith from nth of both sides.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__nth_zip_with_nothing_r
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth of zipWith is Nothing past the right side.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__succ_inj
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Successor is injective. Kept: Rete/NetworkOrder.idr uses it.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__sum_by_ext
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Pointwise equal summands sum equal.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__sum_by_lte
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Pointwise LTE summands sum LTE.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__sum_by_strict
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Pointwise LTE with one strict summand sums strictly.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_concat_map
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All over concatMap.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_imp
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All is monotone in the property.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_set_at
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. All survives updating one position with a property-preserving function.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__all_zip
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Two Alls give All of the pair.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_append_false
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool non-membership in ++ is non-membership in both.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_elem_by
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool membership gives Elem for any sound Eq.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_l_true_by
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem gives Bool membership for any reflexive Eq.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_ll_elem
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool membership gives Elem on lists of naturals.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__elem_ll_true
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Elem gives Bool membership on lists of naturals.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_all_false
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A predicate false everywhere filters everything out.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_all_true
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A predicate true everywhere filters nothing out.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__just_injective
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Just is injective. Kept local: Idris 2 0.8.0's base has no Injective Just instance and does not export justInjective.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__list_nat_eq_refl
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool equality on lists of naturals is reflexive.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__list_nat_eq_true
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. And sound.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__map_id_all
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A map that fixes every element is the identity.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__map_set_at
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. map commutes with a position update the map cannot see.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__pair_just
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Just of a pair, componentwise.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__zero_not_succ
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Zero is no successor.

idris.name: Lcyc_1_1__progress
idris.note: What one firing's actions have done relative to the post-pop state: strata below the firing one untouched, the firing one either strictly lower or unchanged in both components.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__certified_terminates
idris.note: THE THEOREM: a certified program reaches an empty agenda from every input working memory, by well-founded recursion on the lexicographic measure. `partial` because it establishes the clause for a FRAGMENT rather than for the language: programs meeting the certificate of Lcyc/Certificate.idr (a kind emitted and read in one SCC is a key-all `logical` relation not withdrawn there, emitted values are literals or copies), which is wider than [LCYC.3.1.1]: the clause admits no emitted-and-read kind at all, the certificate admits a recursive exception. Every program the clause admits over the KIND-LEVEL graph meets the certificate, so the theorem covers those and more; but [LCYC.6.1] drops an edge the kind graph keeps when the emit's literal refutes every positive pattern of the target, and [LCYC.3.1.1] admits over that pruned graph, so a program admitted only by the break (`compiler/LCYC.6.1_self_edge_kind_flip_ok`, [LCYC.6.1.3]'s staged derivation) has a kind-level edge inside an SCC and no certificate here: the theorem is silent on it, and its termination rests on the break's argument, stated in [LCYC.6.1] and proved nowhere. The engine is the deterministic model of Rete/FireLoop.idr: source-order firing [LDET.5.1], pop on fire [IRET.11.4], NOT release in place [LDET.5.9], the three lifecycles of [LFAC.2.6.1]/[LFAC.1.7.2]; no TMS, time, `call` or cache. The compiler's rule graph being the model's graph is argued, not proved.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp1_emit_lt
idris.note: A relation emit of a kind the stratum reads strictly lowers its first component.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp1_frame
idris.note: A change to a kind the stratum neither reads nor withdraws leaves its first component alone.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp1_withdraw_lt
idris.note: A withdraw strictly lowers the withdrawing stratum's first component.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp2_ext
idris.note: The pending count depends only on the stratum's own tables.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp2_frame
idris.note: A change to a kind the stratum does not read leaves its pending count alone.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__find_just
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. What find returns passed the test and is a member.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__headroom_append_lte
idris.note: Appending a fact never raises a kind's headroom.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__headroom_sum_append_lte
idris.note: Nor the headroom sum over a stratum's kinds.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__indexed_from_elem
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Membership in the indexed list gives nth.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__indexed_from_nth
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. nth gives membership in the indexed list.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__init_inv
idris.note: The initial state satisfies the invariant with the domain of the program's literals and the input's values.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lex_from
idris.note: Progress plus the pop gives lexicographic decrease of the measure vector.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lt_plus_left
idris.note: Library lemma of the [LCYC.1.1] termination proof, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Equality on the left summand, LT on the right, gives LT of sums.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__lt_plus_right

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__pop_comp2_other
idris.note: And leaves every other stratum's alone.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__pop_comp2_own
idris.note: The pop strictly lowers the firing stratum's pending count.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__progress_change
idris.note: Progress extends through one working-memory change: either it lowered its stratum's first component or its stratum does not read the kind.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__propagate_inv
idris.note: Propagation preserves the invariant.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__propagate_inv_from
idris.note: Propagating well-formed tables against a domain-valued working memory gives an invariant-satisfying state; settledness of the input tables is not needed.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__quiesces
idris.note: From every invariant-satisfying state some number of firings empties the agenda; well-founded recursion on the measure's accessibility.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__step_decreases_inv
idris.note: One firing strictly lowers the measure and preserves the invariant -- the induction step, for certified programs.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__and_false_of_true
idris.note: A false conjunction with a true right side has a false left side.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__certified_terminates_tms
idris.note: THE THEOREM WITH TRUTH MAINTENANCE. A positive program certified at kind level as [LCYC.3.1.1] admits it reaches an empty agenda from every input with unique ids, on the deterministic engine with logical retraction in the loop. `lcyc_1_1__certified_terminates` re-proved for Rete/FireLoopTms.idr's engine. `partial`: the certificate is over the kind-level graph, and a program [LCYC.3.1.1] admits only through [LCYC.6.1]'s literal break has none, so the theorem does not reach it.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp1_frame_pred
idris.note: A stratum reading no kind of the change keeps its comp1: every kind its measure mentions is one it reads.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__comp2_frame_pred
idris.note: A stratum reading no kind of the change keeps its comp2: its rules' tables are unchanged by the propagation.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__headroom_frame_pred
idris.note: Headroom of a kind outside the change is unchanged.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__quiesces_tms
idris.note: A certified positive program quiesces from every invariant-satisfying state with truth maintenance: well-founded recursion on the measure's accessibility.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__step_tms_decreases
idris.note: THE STEP. One firing with truth maintenance decreases the measure and keeps the run invariant and the kinds of the rows' targets: the pop takes one from its stratum's pending count, and the actions with their cascades touch nothing below the firing stratum and either lower its comp1 or leave both of its components alone. The core's lexicographic assembly, reused.

idris.name: Lcyc_1_1__halts_at
idris.note: Quiescence after exactly n firings: still running after n, empty agenda after n + 1.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__diverges_from
idris.note: Divergence from a reached state is divergence from the start.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__periodic_diverges
idris.note: A run whose state literally recurs after S k firings diverges.

idris.name: Lcyc_1_1__diverges
idris.note: Non-termination stated positively: from the state, every finite number of firings is possible. What a witness of unbounded computation establishes.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__sum_by
idris.note: Sum of a function over a list, by structural recursion.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_filter_imp
idris.note: Filtering by a test that implies an earlier one is filtering by it alone.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__map_map_all
idris.note: Mapping twice is mapping the composite, given pointwise.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_ext_on
idris.note: Two tests that agree on every member filter alike.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__filter_filter
idris.note: Filtering twice is filtering by the conjunction: probing then testing is testing both.

idris.name: lcyc_1_1__inv_widen
idris.note: The core invariant is monotone in the domain.
